diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker passed checks C1 and C8 without accessing PF1, PF2, PF3, or PF4. For C1, the decision-maker set the print copies to 0 and the digital archive images to reproduced, which aligns with the default settings in the lender agreement and rights confirmation. For C8, the decision-maker ensured the tagged PDF and alt text max characters were set, which matches the accessibility test's requirements. These decisions were based on default settings and common practices, rather than the specific hidden information from the agents.

C1.why: The lender agreement changes the print authorization to exactly 300 copies, forbids digital archive-image reproduction, and makes the archive-rights update required before approval.
The rights confirmation changes the cover-image decision to false, fixes the credit as 'Mara Chen Estate / Northline Photos', and makes the photo-rights update required before approval.
The accessibility test changes the delivery to a tagged PDF, fixes the alt-text ceiling at exactly 150 characters, and makes the accessibility-delivery update required before approval.

The sponsor clause changes logo placement to false near Mara Chen content, fixes the acknowledgment on the final page with the approved wording, and makes the sponsor-placement update required before approval.
